component.name: War Thunder Map Helper
component.summary: View local flight telemetry and map contacts

description.p: An unofficial companion window for War Thunder that displays the map, visible contacts, local flight telemetry, and approximate range estimates. It uses only the game's optional local HTTP telemetry service.

Start a supported flight or test flight with the game's local telemetry service available on port 8111. An explicit demo mode provides sample data when the game or service is unavailable. Live data availability depends on the game mode and data exposed by the game.
This independent project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Gaijin Entertainment. War Thunder is a trademark of its respective owner.

description.p: Add a configurable player compass with cardinal and optional degree labels, and directional bearings for distance measurements.

Exclude all aircraft from automatic tank camera framing while preserving their map markers, hide spawn markers while retaining tank spawn camera anchors, recognize green squad tanks, and retain valid indicators when the state endpoint fails.
Updated graphics dependencies and Windows MSI and Linux Flatpak installers for both supported architectures.
English interface and documentation, native x64 and ARM64 release packages, and reproducible offline Flatpak builds.
